top_offers.title: Founding Engineer (Fullstack / AI)
top_offers.why: YC-backed open-source visual code editor with 19k+ GitHub stars and #1 on Hacker News, hiring its first Founding Engineer on a React/TypeScript stack. AI-powered code editing lines up closely with Magino's AI-augmented engineering focus and founding-engineer track record from Alaya, though the role is SF/US-remote only.

top_offers.title: Founding AI Engineer
top_offers.why: YC F25 startup building an LLM+RAG pipeline that reads CAD/PDF files for building-code compliance, on a React/Node/Postgres stack, a close technical match. Genuine 0-to-1 founding scope with heavy LLM exposure, but it's a US-based team and remote-Europe fit isn't confirmed.

top_offers.title: Founding DevOps / Platform Engineer
top_offers.why: Founding DevOps/Platform Engineer building core infrastructure from scratch at an early-stage startup, with remote flexibility that's workable from Geneva. Founding-level ownership matches Magino's builder profile well, though the posting is thin on AI angle and compensation.
